name: Manali
description: Mountain destination with snowy peaks, trekking, skiing and cold weather. Popular for snow activities, river valleys, pine forests and adventure sports like paragliding and zorbing.

name: Shimla
description: Hill station with cool climate, mountain views, colonial architecture and peaceful surroundings. Known for the Mall Road, the Ridge, toy train rides and pleasant evening walks, ideal for families and couples.

name: Goa
description: Coastal destination with sandy beaches, nightlife, water sports and seafood. Offers beach parties, Portuguese heritage churches, flea markets and relaxed sunset views along the sea.

name: Jaipur
description: Historic city with royal palaces, forts, cultural heritage and traditional markets. Famous for Amber Fort, City Palace, handicraft bazaars and Rajasthani food, a great pick for history lovers.

name: Rishikesh
description: Adventure destination famous for river rafting, camping, yoga and Himalayan scenery. Also known for bungee jumping, riverside cafes, meditation retreats and the evening Ganga aarti.

name: Munnar
description: Scenic hill station with tea plantations, green valleys, misty mountains and cool weather. Great for quiet walks, waterfalls, tea museums and relaxing getaways surrounded by greenery.

name: Darjeeling
description: Mountain destination with tea gardens, Himalayan views, cool weather and scenic toy train rides. Famous for sunrise views over Kanchenjunga, tea estates and monasteries, with a calm hill town atmosphere.

name: Ooty
description: Hill station with botanical gardens, tea plantations, lakes and pleasant weather. Popular for boating, a heritage mountain railway, rose gardens and easy relaxing family holidays.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Tropical islands with clear water, coral reefs, scuba diving and sandy beaches. Ideal for snorkelling, island hopping, clear blue sea and relaxing seaside stays.

name: Leh
description: High altitude mountain destination with dramatic landscapes, monasteries, trekking and adventure. Known for high passes, Buddhist culture, road trips, camping and starry night skies.

name: Udaipur
description: Historic city with beautiful lakes, royal palaces, heritage hotels and traditional architecture. Called the city of lakes, with boat rides, sunset views, romantic settings and rich Rajasthani culture.

name: Coorg
description: Green hill destination with coffee plantations, forests, waterfalls and peaceful surroundings. Known for coffee estates, misty mornings, trekking trails and quiet homestays.

name: McLeod Ganj
description: Mountain destination with trekking trails, monasteries, misty hills and peaceful surroundings. Home to Tibetan culture, cafes, scenic walks and quiet hill views near the Dhauladhar range.

name: Pondicherry
description: Coastal town with beaches, French colonial architecture, cafes and relaxing seaside promenades. Known for tranquil streets, yoga ashrams, heritage villas and a relaxed French-influenced seaside culture.

name: Varanasi
description: Historic spiritual city with ancient temples, riverfront ghats and rich cultural heritage. Famous for the evening Ganga aarti, boat rides on the river, narrow lanes and ancient spiritual traditions.

name: Srinagar
description: Mountain destination with Dal Lake, houseboats, snow-capped peaks and beautiful gardens. Known for shikara rides, Mughal gardens, local handicrafts and calm lakeside views.

name: Gulmarg
description: Mountain destination famous for skiing, snowfall, snowy slopes and winter adventure sports. Features one of the highest gondola rides, snow trekking and heavy winter snowfall scenery.

name: Nainital
description: Hill station surrounded by mountains with a scenic lake, boating and cool weather. Great for boat rides, ropeway views, local markets and easy relaxing family trips.

name: Mussoorie
description: Hill station with mountain views, waterfalls, misty valleys and pleasant weather. Known as the queen of hills, with Mall Road walks, cable car rides, Kempty Falls and cool breezy evenings.

name: Auli
description: Mountain destination known for skiing, snowy slopes, Himalayan views and winter adventure. Offers cable car rides, skiing training, snow trekking and views of Nanda Devi.

name: Kedarnath
description: Mountain pilgrimage destination surrounded by Himalayan peaks and trekking routes. A sacred Shiva temple reached by a long trek, popular with pilgrims and trekkers seeking spiritual calm.

name: Spiti Valley
description: Remote mountain valley with dramatic landscapes, monasteries, cold desert scenery and trekking. Known for high altitude villages, ancient monasteries, starry skies and rugged road trips.

name: Kasol
description: Mountain village with riverside camping, trekking trails, forests and peaceful surroundings. Popular with backpackers for the Parvati river, cafes, short treks and relaxed village life.

name: Kasauli
description: Quiet hill station with pine forests, colonial buildings, scenic walking trails and cool weather. A calm, uncrowded getaway for short walks, birdwatching and quiet weekends.

name: Dalhousie
description: Mountain town with pine forests, colonial architecture, green valleys and peaceful scenery. Offers nearby Khajjiar meadows, short hikes, old churches and slow relaxing holidays.

name: Kodaikanal
description: Hill station with lakes, forests, waterfalls, misty mountains and cool climate. Known for pine forests, a star-shaped lake, cycling, viewpoints and peaceful hill walks.

name: Wayanad
description: Nature destination with forests, wildlife, waterfalls, green hills and scenic trekking trails. Home to caves, tribal heritage, tea and spice plantations and rich bird and wildlife watching.

name: Alleppey
description: Backwater destination with houseboats, lagoons, coconut trees and relaxing water journeys. Famous for overnight houseboat stays, canoe rides, village life and calm green backwaters.

name: Kochi
description: Coastal city with historic streets, Chinese fishing nets, heritage buildings and seaside attractions. Known for old spice markets, art cafes, Kathakali shows and sunset walks by the harbour.

name: Mahabalipuram
description: Historic coastal town with ancient stone temples, rock carvings and UNESCO heritage monuments. Features the Shore Temple, beach views, sculpture workshops and a relaxed coastal feel.

name: Hampi
description: Historic destination with ancient ruins, stone temples, archaeological sites and remarkable landscapes. Famous for the Vittala Temple, boulder hills, coracle rides and sunrise views over the ruins.

name: Mysuru
description: Cultural city with royal palaces, historic monuments, gardens and traditional markets. Known for the illuminated Mysore Palace, silk, sandalwood, Dasara celebrations and peaceful gardens.

name: Pune
description: City destination with nearby forts, cultural attractions, pleasant hill getaways and trekking routes. Features Shaniwar Wada, Sinhagad Fort treks, cafes and a lively student culture.

name: Lonavala
description: Hill station with green valleys, waterfalls, scenic viewpoints and monsoon trekking trails. Popular for rain-soaked weekends, ancient caves, lakes and lush greenery.

name: Mahabaleshwar
description: Hill station with strawberry farms, forests, mountain viewpoints and cool weather. Known for fresh strawberries, viewpoints, boating and peaceful nature walks.

name: Mumbai
description: Coastal metropolitan city with beaches, historic architecture, entertainment and vibrant street food. Home to the Gateway of India, Marine Drive, Bollywood culture and busy sunset beaches.

name: Ajanta Caves
description: Historic destination featuring ancient Buddhist cave monuments, paintings and rock-cut architecture. A UNESCO World Heritage Site with ancient murals and sculptures, ideal for art and history lovers.

name: Mount Abu
description: Hill station with forested hills, peaceful lakes, cool weather and historic Jain temples. The only hill station in Rajasthan, popular for sunset points, lake boating and cool breezy evenings.

name: Jaisalmer
description: Desert city with golden sandstone forts, historic havelis, camel safaris and cultural experiences. Known as the golden city, with desert camping, folk music, sand dunes and starry nights.

name: Jodhpur
description: Historic city with Mehrangarh Fort, royal palaces, blue-painted houses and cultural heritage. Called the blue city, with spice markets, stepwell cafes, zip-lining and panoramic fort views.

name: Khajuraho
description: Historic destination known for intricate temple architecture, sculptures and cultural heritage. A UNESCO site famous for medieval carvings, light and sound shows and quiet heritage walks.

name: Pachmarhi
description: Nature destination with forested hills, waterfalls, caves and scenic walking trails. Called the queen of Satpura, with pools, ancient rock paintings and quiet forest stays.

name: Kaziranga National Park
description: Wildlife destination famous for one-horned rhinoceroses, grasslands, forests and nature safaris. A UNESCO site known for jeep and elephant safaris, birdwatching and wetland landscapes.

name: Shillong
description: Hill destination with green mountains, waterfalls, caves, pleasant weather and scenic viewpoints. Called the Scotland of the East, with music culture, cafes, lakes and cool breezy weather.

name: Cherrapunji
description: Nature destination with dramatic waterfalls, living root bridges, caves and misty green hills. One of the wettest places on Earth, popular for monsoon waterfalls, cave exploring and root bridge treks.

name: Gangtok
description: Mountain city with Himalayan views, monasteries, scenic lakes and adventure excursions. Known for ropeway rides, local markets, mountain views and easy access to nearby high-altitude lakes.

name: Pelling
description: Mountain destination with Kanchenjunga views, monasteries, forests and peaceful surroundings. Offers quiet monasteries, sky walk views, waterfalls and calm village stays.

name: Tawang
description: Remote mountain destination with monasteries, high altitude scenery, cold weather and peaceful valleys. Home to the largest monastery in India, snowy passes, frozen lakes and rich Buddhist culture.

name: Ziro Valley
description: Scenic valley with green hills, rice fields, forests, traditional villages and peaceful surroundings. Known for music festivals, pine hills, bamboo groves and the unique Apatani tribal culture.

name: Puri
description: Coastal destination with sandy beaches, historic temples, seaside attractions and cultural experiences. Famous for the Jagannath Temple, the Rath Yatra festival, fresh seafood and long golden beaches.

name: Konark
description: Historic coastal destination famous for the Sun Temple, stone architecture and cultural heritage. Features a chariot-shaped temple with intricate carvings, a nearby beach and the Chandrabhaga fair.

name: Chopta
description: Mountain meadow destination with rhododendron forests, Himalayan peaks and the Tungnath trekking route. Often called mini Switzerland, it is quiet, scenic and ideal for camping and short treks.

name: Lansdowne
description: Quiet hill station with oak and pine forests, colonial cantonment charm and peaceful viewpoints. A calm, uncrowded getaway for nature walks and cool weather.

name: Almora
description: Mountain town with Himalayan sunrise views, ancient temples, handicraft markets and Kumaoni culture. Peaceful, scenic and perfect for slow hill holidays.

name: Ranikhet
description: Peaceful hill station with pine forests, golf grounds, Himalayan views and cool weather. A quiet retreat for nature walks, birdwatching and relaxing stays.

name: Munsiyari
description: Remote Himalayan village with close views of snow-covered Panchachuli peaks, alpine meadows and trekking trails. Offers peaceful surroundings and high altitude adventure.

name: Pahalgam
description: Mountain valley with the Lidder river, pine forests, green meadows and pony treks. Known for cool weather, scenic beauty and as the gateway to the Amarnath yatra route.

name: Sonamarg
description: Mountain destination with glaciers, alpine lakes, snowy meadows and trekking routes. Famous for the Thajiwas Glacier, cold weather and dramatic Himalayan scenery.

name: Lachung
description: High altitude mountain village with snowy peaks, apple orchards, hot springs and the nearby Yumthang Valley. Known for snowfall in winter, cold weather and peaceful scenery.

name: Kalimpong
description: Quiet hill town with orchid nurseries, monasteries, colonial houses and views of Kanchenjunga. Peaceful, misty and less crowded than nearby Darjeeling.

name: Kullu
description: Mountain valley with the Beas river, apple orchards, temples and the Great Himalayan National Park nearby. Popular for river rafting, trekking and cool pleasant weather.

name: Bir Billing
description: Adventure destination known as the paragliding capital of India, with Buddhist monasteries and tea gardens. Offers hill views, camping, trekking and thrilling flights over the Dhauladhar mountains.

name: Tirthan Valley
description: Offbeat mountain valley with trout fishing, riverside camping, forest treks and the Great Himalayan National Park. Peaceful, uncrowded and ideal for hiking and nature lovers.

name: Nubra Valley
description: High altitude desert valley with sand dunes, double-humped camels, monasteries and the Khardung La pass. Offers road trips, camping and dramatic mountain scenery.

name: Zanskar Valley
description: Remote Himalayan valley with deep gorges, ancient monasteries and challenging trekking routes. Famous for rafting and the frozen river Chadar trek in cold winters.

name: Yuksom
description: Historic mountain village and starting point for the Kanchenjunga and Dzongri treks. Offers forest trails, monasteries, camping and peaceful Himalayan views.

name: Dandeli
description: Forest adventure destination with white water rafting on the Kali river, kayaking, jungle safaris and camping. Popular for wildlife, birdwatching and monsoon thrills.

name: Kolad
description: Adventure destination on the Kundalika river with white water rafting, camping, zip lining and waterfall treks. A popular monsoon getaway close to Mumbai and Pune.

name: Valley of Flowers
description: UNESCO nature reserve with alpine meadows of wildflowers, glacial streams and Himalayan peaks. Reached by a scenic trek and best visited during the monsoon bloom.

name: Pangong Lake
description: High altitude lake with changing shades of blue, barren mountains and starry night skies. Offers lakeside camping, photography and peaceful, dramatic scenery.

name: Majuli
description: River island on the Brahmaputra with Vaishnavite monasteries, bamboo houses, migratory birds and traditional mask-making. Peaceful, green and rich in tribal culture.

name: Mawlynnong
description: Spotless village known as one of the cleanest in Asia, with living root bridges, bamboo skywalks and lush forests. Peaceful, green and perfect for slow nature walks.

name: Dawki
description: Border town on the crystal clear Umngot river with boating, riverside camping and green hills. Famous for transparent water, scenic views and relaxing boat rides.

name: Jim Corbett National Park
description: Wildlife destination with tiger reserves, jeep safaris, forests, elephants and river views. Popular for birdwatching, jungle stays and nature photography.

name: Ranthambore National Park
description: Wildlife destination famous for tiger safaris, ancient fort ruins, lakes and dry deciduous forests. Ideal for nature photography and jungle experiences.

name: Gir National Park
description: Wildlife sanctuary and the only home of the Asiatic lion, with forests, jeep safaris and rich birdlife. Ideal for nature lovers and wildlife photography.

name: Sundarbans
description: Mangrove forest delta with Royal Bengal tigers, boat safaris, rivers and rich wildlife. A UNESCO site offering unique nature and birdwatching experiences.

name: Thekkady
description: Nature destination around Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary with spice plantations, boat rides, elephants and forest treks. Green, scenic and peaceful, with cool pleasant weather.

name: Bandipur National Park
description: Wildlife destination with deciduous forests, tigers, elephants, jungle safaris and nearby hills. Known for birdwatching, nature stays and peaceful green surroundings.

name: Chikmagalur
description: Hill destination with coffee estates, misty mountains, waterfalls and the Mullayanagiri trek. Peaceful, green and perfect for relaxing nature stays.

name: Araku Valley
description: Scenic valley with coffee plantations, tribal villages, waterfalls, caves and a famous train ride through green hills. Cool, quiet and perfect for nature lovers.

name: Tadoba National Park
description: Wildlife destination with dense teak forests, lakes, tiger safaris and rich birdlife. Popular for jungle stays, nature photography and peaceful forest experiences.

name: Gokarna
description: Coastal town with quiet beaches, sacred temples, cliffside views and beach treks. Relaxed, peaceful and less crowded than the busier beaches of Goa.

name: Varkala
description: Coastal destination with cliff-top beaches, natural springs, cafes and ayurvedic spas. Known for relaxing sea views, sunsets and yoga retreats.

name: Kovalam
description: Beach destination with crescent-shaped sandy shores, lighthouse views, surfing and ayurvedic massage centres. Popular for swimming, seafood and relaxing seaside stays.

name: Kanyakumari
description: Coastal town at the southern tip of India where three seas meet, famous for sunrise and sunset views. Features the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and seaside temples.

name: Diu
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Island beach town with Portuguese forts, quiet beaches, old churches and seaside cafes. Relaxing, uncrowded and perfect for water sports and calm sea views.

name: Lakshadweep
description: Tropical coral islands with clear lagoons, white sandy beaches, scuba diving and snorkelling. Remote, peaceful and ideal for water sports and island holidays.

name: Neil Island
description: Quiet island with calm beaches, coral reefs, a natural rock bridge and snorkelling spots. Relaxed, peaceful and ideal for sunsets and clear water.

name: Digha
description: Popular seaside town with long shallow beaches, casuarina trees and fresh seafood. A budget friendly weekend getaway for families and relaxing sea walks.

name: Alibaug
description: Coastal town with calm beaches, sea forts, water sports and seaside villas. A quick relaxing weekend getaway near Mumbai with fresh seafood.

name: Tarkarli
description: Beach destination with clear water, scuba diving, snorkelling, dolphin spotting and the Sindhudurg sea fort. Peaceful, uncrowded and known for Malvani seafood.

name: Rushikonda
description: Beach destination on the coast of Visakhapatnam with golden sand, water sports, hill views and a seaside promenade. Popular for swimming, surfing and relaxed seaside evenings.

name: Agra
description: Historic city with the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Mughal architecture and old bazaars. Known for marble inlay craft, Mughlai food and rich cultural heritage.

name: Delhi
description: Capital city with the Red Fort, Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb and historic markets of Old Delhi. Offers rich heritage, museums, street food and a mix of ancient and modern culture.

name: Amritsar
description: Historic spiritual city with the Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh and the Wagah border ceremony. Known for community kitchens, Punjabi food and rich Sikh heritage.

name: Hyderabad
description: Historic city with Charminar, Golconda Fort, Nizam palaces and old bazaars. Famous for biryani, pearls and rich cultural heritage.

name: Gwalior
description: Historic city with a massive hill fort, royal palaces, ancient temples and music heritage. Known for forts, museums and cultural traditions.

name: Orchha
description: Medieval town on the Betwa river with palaces, temples, royal cenotaphs and quiet streets. Peaceful, less crowded and ideal for history lovers.

name: Chittorgarh
description: Historic fort city with the largest fort in India, towers, palaces and tales of Rajput valor. Known for heritage monuments and cultural festivals.

name: Bodh Gaya
description: Spiritual and historic town with the Mahabodhi Temple, the sacred Bodhi tree and monasteries from many countries. Peaceful, calm and rich in Buddhist heritage.

name: Madurai
description: Ancient temple city with the Meenakshi Amman Temple, bustling bazaars and Tamil culture. Known for colorful gopurams, jasmine markets and traditional food.

name: Thanjavur
description: Historic city with the Brihadeeswarar Temple, Chola architecture, palaces and art museums. Famous for bronze sculptures, classical music and Tanjore paintings.

name: Bijapur
description: Historic city with the Gol Gumbaz dome, Islamic architecture, ancient mosques and old forts. Known for its whispering gallery, monuments and Deccan heritage.

name: Lucknow
description: Historic city of nawabs with Bara Imambara, Rumi Darwaza, old gardens and rich culture. Known for Awadhi cuisine, chikankari embroidery and refined traditions.

name: Pushkar
description: Sacred lake town with the Brahma Temple, ghats, a camel fair and colorful markets. Known for its spiritual atmosphere, desert views and cultural festivals.

name: Mandu
description: Ancient fortress town with Afghan architecture, palaces, mosques and views across green valleys. Romantic ruins that look beautiful during monsoon.

name: Ahmedabad
description: UNESCO heritage city with stepwells, old pols, Sabarmati Ashram and Islamic monuments. Known for textile markets, Gujarati food and cultural heritage.

name: Sanchi
description: Historic Buddhist site with ancient stupas, carved gateways and monasteries from the Mauryan era. A UNESCO World Heritage Site that is calm, quiet and ideal for history lovers.
